revisions.charge_roar_v2:
Game asset for Legend of Agarica. Match the attached reference sprites exactly: same character design, SAME SCALE ~400px tall in neutral knuckle stance (including crown). Crisp pixel-art, pure-white fur, no painterly restyling. Canvas1536x1024 true TRANSPARENT alpha. Each animation row has exactly FOUR distinct chronological poses, left to right. Each frame centered in384px-wide cell, at least40px empty space between frames and60px between rows. ONE connected silhouette per character frame, all facing RIGHT. No text, ground, cast shadow, background, external glow, dust, chips, motion lines or shockwaves. Toxic moss is attached to fur/crown. Entire silhouette including arms/crown/held rock stays inside cell, preferably maxwidth330px. Feet/lowest point aligned on common baseline per row. KAINATI, KING OF THE SIMIANS (corrupted boss) - must match the existing reference art exactly: a huge gorilla-like ape king, thick shaggy pure-white fur with black outlines, dark grey skin on face, chest, hands and feet, glowing green eyes, angry heavy brow, red tribal paint stripes on his cheek, a tall carved Maya-like stone crown/headdress made of grey-beige stone blocks with spiral glyphs, thick brown vine bracelets wrapped around wrists and ankles, patches of glowing toxic-green moss stuck in his fur and on his crown. Knuckle-walking stance. Clearly pixel-art style, thick dark outline, side view, facing RIGHT.
Two rows512px high. Keep all art between y45..455 in row1 and y565..975 in row2, preserve the same body scale across both rows; upright poses naturally taller while crouched poses lower. Row1 CHARGE, heavy knuckle-running loop: 1 arms reaching forward, fists contacting ground; 2 body lifted with legs tucked underneath; 3 hind legs push off, body stretched forward; 4 landing on fists. Row2 ROAR: 1 rises onto hind legs; 2 both fists beat chest; 3 head thrown back, mouth wide open roaring; 4 drops back onto knuckles. Exactly8 isolated poses4/4.
CRITICAL CORRECTION for production: reference style must remain, but do not draw oversized broad poses spanning adjacent cells. Each neutral gorilla MUST measure approximately400px high and no more than320px wide, tall compact silhouette, STRICT PROFILE so shoulders/knuckles overlap horizontally rather than broad front-view shoulders. Keep a large visible transparent gutter between columns. Four separate isolated sprites per row, no touching. For stretched running frame, bend/tuck rear leg so entire silhouette still <=330px wide. Image must be1536x1024. The top and bottom animation rows must use the SAME head/crown size. Foot baseline y460 for row1,y1000 for row2, all crowns/arms fully inside cells.
